hypothesis: Independent rank and suit encoders might reduce cross-glyph shortcuts contributing to suit errors
structural_checks: Changing rank pixels cannot affect suit logits
Changing suit pixels cannot affect rank logits
Suit gradients do not enter rank inputs

selection.clean: Worst source validation accuracy, then pooled accuracy; first tie wins
selection.robust: Clean plus three frozen augmented views per source; worst source/view accuracy, then pooled accuracy, then minimum validation cross-entropy
selection.view_order: Primary/rehearsal clean, then primary/rehearsal for each augmented view

interpretation: Separate encoders satisfy structural isolation but do not improve captured glyph generalization. Perfect clean or augmented synthetic validation is insufficient; this does not establish cross-glyph leakage as the cause of the audit failures.
checkpoint_storage: Failed weights remain local under apc/runs; architecture, recipes, fingerprints and full evaluations are committed, no default weights replaced
next_work: Broaden independently generated suit font/rasterization coverage and retain old-domain rehearsal, then test with new captures rather than optimizing against the sealed audit
